calculation.description: Ranks assets whose recent 20-session return exceeds one third of their 60-session return, normalized by recent downside volatility. Higher values indicate improving medium-term trend on a risk-adjusted basis. Computed using data available at each observation date only.

validation.regime_notes: Full-history 20-day paper IC and ICIR pass benchmark gates. The signal is currently adverse: online IC -0.0223924/ICIR -0.0765918, recent 252 observations IC -0.0875245/ICIR -0.3100654, and 2029 YTD IC -0.0610610/ICIR -0.2165801. Use conservative weight pending revalidation; small 15-asset cross-section implies uncertainty.

signal_provenance.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC across exactly 15 tradable benchmark instruments; minimum 8 valid instruments/date; no future data in signal construction
